name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2478: The push was blocked three times. v2477 shortened the inbox panel so its action row cleared the dock - correct - and the gate then refused it for a DIFFERENT reason at 1120x628 only: 1 element covered by something on top, tab-content active over. Idle it was green 4 runs of 4; under the gate, straight after test_controls 425s of CPU, it was red. Two things were wrong and only one of them was mine. FIRST, v2477s height depended on a JS observer publishing inbox-top, so the panel was only safe AFTER javascript ran - proven by suppressing the publication, which turned the target red on an idle machine too. A layout whose correctness races a ResizeObserver is green when the machine is quiet and red when it is busy, which is the worst possible arrangement for a gate. The static value now carries the worst measured gap and a floor, so the measurement can only relax it. SECOND, and this was the real one: the coverage probe flagged a row that had merely SCROLLED OUT of the shortened panel. Such a row still reports a layout rect, so the sampled point lands on whatever is painted there and the ancestor is recorded as covering it. Tuning the panel height only moved the failure between two messages, which is how you learn the instrument is the thing that cannot tell them apart. This files own prose had already said so: it is one scroll away, not unreachable.
